headings.text: Our Quality Painting Service is just a call away

paragraphs: High Quality Painting Service for the Cairns Region
At MrPaint, we provide protective coating solutions tailored to each clients needs.
We use industrial grade products along with specialised application methods to ensure long term durability and protection of even the most weather beaten and corrosive surfaces.
Whether it be high pressure water cleaning, lead paint removal or getting to those hard to reach places, MrPaint has you covered.
Our experienced team can deliver a tailored solution to you at anytime- including after hours, public holidays and weekends.

At MrPaint we provide after hours and weekend flooring solutions for your business. Our industrial epoxy solutions are anti-slip and water resistant ensuring longevity and peace of mind for our clients.
